verdict.rationale: Devin is documented as a conversational agent that you can ask to reproduce and fix bugs, including by tagging it on a Slack or Teams thread about a bug. Ask Devin answers natural-language questions about code structure, and Auto-Fix iterates on CI failures and flagged bugs. Community reports that it sometimes runs in circles instead of admitting it is stuck lower confidence, but they do not concretely contradict the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the debugging workflow (logs, stack traces, interactive diagnosis), and independent hands-on corroboration of successful natural-language troubleshooting.
